newsitem.title: EGYPT: Hoechst Orient bond subscribed 3.8 times.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst Orient bond subscribed 3.8 times.

text.p: Hoechst Orient received applications for five-year corporate bonds worth 113.272 million pounds ($33.3 million), 3.78 times the 30 million pounds it was seeking, the company said on Thursday.
The offer closed on Thursday at the end of the statutory minimum period of 10 days, it added in a statement.
The bonds will pay interest every six months at 0.25 percentage points above the average yield on Egyptian six-month treasury bills, which now stands at 10.115 percent.
The issue is of 300,000 bonds with a nominal value of 100 pounds, issued at par. There were 252 subscribers, it said.
Hoechst Orient, a subsidiary of the German company Hoechst AG, became in 1994 the first company in five decades to issue corporate bonds in the Egyptian market.
